kjv: with their suburbs for their cattle
mine: with their pasturelands for their livestock
note: migrash means the open pasture land around a town; "suburbs" now suggests residential outskirts.

kjv: a great man among the Anakims
mine: the greatest man among the Anakim
note: ha'adam haggadol ba'anaqim is superlative by context (the eponymous founder of the Anakim).
